senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
A vender of the flesh or meat, either of beasts or birds.
E.
वीतंस a snare or net, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A hireling, a labourer.
2 A stipendiary.
E.
वेतन wages, hire, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Sacrificial, sacred, (as fire.)
n. (-कं)
Burnt-offering, especially of clarified butter, as presented daily by the Brahmans.
E.
वितान the hearth, ठक् aff.

f. (-णिः-णी)
1 The river of hell.
2 The mother of the Rākṣasas.
E.
वि various, तरण crossing, aff. इञ् or अण्, and ङीष् aff., or वि prohibitive, तरणी crossing; or वितरण giving, (liberality in life securing a passage); or again, वि priv. तरणी a boat, passed without a boat; the affix is the same.

m. (-सः)
A sort of cane, (Calamus fasciculatus.)
E.
वेतस the Ratan, अण् pleonasm.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Sacrificial, sacred, (as fire.)
n. (-नं)
Oblation with fire.
E.
वितान the hole in the hearth in which sacred fire is kept, and अण् aff.

f. (-ना)
The regular presentation of burnt-offering morning and evening.
E.
वैतान sacrificial, (fire,) and उपासना service.

m. (-कः)
1 A bard whose duty it is to awaken a chief or prince at dawn with music and song.
2 A singer out of tune (?)
3 One who has a demon for a familiar, the servant of a Vetāla.
E.
वि privative, &c. ताल tune, अण् aff., and ठक् added.

m. (-यः)
A kind of metre, or tetrastich, the first and third lines of which contain the time of fourteen short syllables, and the second and fourth of sixteen; it admits of some varieties.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Cany, reedy, relating to a cane, &c.
E.
वेत्र a cane, छण aff., with कुक augment, and the final of the aff. rejected.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to a stick or cane.
E.
वेत्र a stick, and छण aff.
